notes: Deploy with the Catalyst CLI: `catalyst init` (link this project), then `catalyst deploy`.
Before deploying, set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY under Functions > chatQuery > Environment Variables in the Catalyst Console.
After deploying, update API_BASE in client/index.html to the function's live execution URL (Console > Functions > chatQuery > Domain).
See README.md for the full step-by-step deployment walkthrough.
